snippet.title: Sinweaver - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Sinweaver is a 2D Metroidvania “Lite” that has you cutting your way through fallen angels and cultists alike as you fight your way through hell to escape a grim afterlife. Explore levels and an interactive overworld map to uncover the worlds secrets and why heavens mightiest have fallen to darkness.
